summary: The Extensible Provisioning Protocol (EPP) lets a registrar client and a registry server agree on which object types and extensions a session uses. This document defines an operational practice for what a server does when it has information tied to a namespace the client did not say it supports. The server can return that information in a way that stays within the negotiated services.

eli5.summary: When a shop assistant has a note about something you did not ask about, there must be a polite way to pass it on. This document gives domain-name computers a safe way to share extra news without confusing the other side.

questions: what happens when epp client does not support an extension
